name: Vermilion VAPT extension
note: Token yang tidak ada di Design.md tapi dibutuhkan dashboard VAPT. Mengikuti konvensi evidence tag milik spec: semuanya (derived). Nilai ditulis sebagai alias {token} ke token spec sedapat mungkin, supaya perubahan di Design.md otomatis turun ke sini.

tokens.name: surface-brand-hover
tokens.usage: Isian brand saat hover (tombol Solid). Terpisah dari brand-hover karena brand-hover adalah warna TINTA: di tema gelap tinta harus lebih terang, sedangkan isian harus tetap gelap agar teks putih di atasnya tetap terbaca.

tokens.name: surface-brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Isian brand saat pressed. Alasan pemisahannya sama dengan surface-brand-hover.

tokens.name: sev-critical
tokens.usage: Identitas severity Critical: warna seri chart dan ground badge. Satu-satunya badge solid di sistem - meminjam pola 'emphasis by fill' StatTile. Sengaja BUKAN brand (red-600), karena spec mengunci brand untuk action dan wayfinding.

tokens.name: sev-critical-fg
tokens.usage: Teks dan ikon Critical di atas ground solid.

tokens.name: sev-low
tokens.usage: Identitas severity Low. Slate netral, bukan hue baru (spec: 'Info uses neutral slate, not a new hue').

tokens.name: sev-info
tokens.usage: Identitas severity Informational: paling ringan, murni netral.

tokens.name: activity-project
tokens.usage: Isian penanda aktivitas Proyek (proyek dibuat/diubah). Ikon putih di atasnya 4.3:1. Isian tidak ikut tema, sama seperti surface-brand.

tokens.name: activity-scope-bg
tokens.usage: Ground varian soft penanda Ruang lingkup.

tokens.name: activity-technical
tokens.usage: Isian penanda aktivitas Teknis. Nilainya sama dengan success terang, tapi sengaja literal: success naik terang di tema gelap dan ikon putih akan gagal kontras.

tokens.name: activity-schedule
tokens.usage: Isian penanda aktivitas Jadwal. Catatan: hampir sewarna dengan activity-assessment (1.03:1) - bedakan lewat ikon.

tokens.name: activity-archive
tokens.usage: Isian penanda aktivitas Arsip. Literal, bukan {ink-muted}, karena ink-muted naik terang di tema gelap.

tokens.name: stage-assessment-bg
tokens.usage: Ground ikon dan kartu tahap Assessment.

tokens.name: stage-analysis-bg
tokens.usage: Ground ikon dan kartu tahap Analysis.

tokens.name: stage-initial-report
tokens.usage: Ikon dan aksen tahap Initial Report (FileText).

tokens.name: stage-initial-report-bg
tokens.usage: Ground ikon dan kartu tahap Initial Report.

tokens.name: stage-remedial-bg
tokens.usage: Ground ikon dan kartu tahap Remedial.

tokens.name: stage-final-presentation
tokens.usage: Ikon dan aksen tahap Final Presentation (Presentation).

tokens.name: stage-final-presentation-bg
tokens.usage: Ground ikon dan kartu tahap Final Presentation.

tokens.name: stage-pending
tokens.usage: Ikon dan aksen status Pending (Clock). Kuning digelapkan ke amber agar ikon lolos 3:1.

tokens.name: stage-pending-bg
tokens.usage: Ground ikon dan kartu status Pending.

tokens.name: stage-done
tokens.usage: Ikon dan aksen status DONE (CircleCheck). Merah brand, bukan hijau, mengikuti referensi desain.

tokens.name: stage-done-bg
tokens.usage: Ground ikon dan kartu status DONE.

tokens.name: inverse-warning
tokens.usage: Teks/ikon warning di atas surface-inverse (kartu gelap). Tidak ikut tema karena surface-inverse gelap di kedua tema.

tokens.name: inverse-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Ground badge warning di atas surface-inverse.

tokens.name: inverse-warning-border
tokens.usage: Border badge warning di atas surface-inverse.
